title: Best of Singapore and Bali Honeymoon
alt: Marina Bay at night in Singapore
transport: Private transfers, city tours and guided day tours

stops.name: Singapore
stops.subtitle: Singapore to Sentosa
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Novena hotel one stop from Orchard Road on the metro

activities.name: Night Safari with tram ride
activities.description: The world's first nocturnal zoo, with a tram ride through seven habitats and walking trails where the animals are at their most active.

activities.name: Singapore city tour
activities.description: A half day tour past Merlion Park, the Marina Bay waterfront, Chinatown and the colonial quarter, with a guide on a shared coach.

activities.name: Singapore river cruise
activities.description: A bumboat along the river past the old godowns of Clarke Quay and Boat Quay, with the Marina Bay skyline lighting up ahead.

activities.name: Universal Studios Singapore
activities.description: A full day ticket for the Sentosa theme park, with seven themed zones, the Battlestar Galactica duelling coasters and the street shows.

program.name: Singapore
program.description: Three nights in the city for your first days together, with a night safari, the river by bumboat and a full day at Universal Studios.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Kintamani and Bedugul
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Surf style hotel five minutes from Kuta beach

activities.name: Kintamani with the jungle swing
activities.description: Coffee plantation tasting, the crater lake view at Kintamani, Tegenungan waterfall, the Tegalalang terraces and a turn on the jungle swing.

activities.name: Bedugul lakes and Tanah Lot sunset
activities.description: The Handara gate, the lake temple of Ulun Danu Beratan at Bedugul, then the sea temple of Tanah Lot as the sun goes down.

activities.name: Kuta beach and the art market
activities.description: The surf beach a few minutes from your hotel, with boards for hire, and the Kuta art market for sarongs, bags and carvings.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights in Bali to finish, with a coffee plantation day up to Kintamani and a temple run that ends at Tanah Lot for sunset.

day_titles.4: On to Bali and Kuta beach

1: Arrival at Changi Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in and freshen up in Novena
Evening tram ride at the Singapore Night Safari
Walking trails past the leopards, tapirs and slow lorises
2: Breakfast, then a half day city tour with a guide
Merlion Park, Marina Bay and the colonial quarter
Chinatown lanes and the Sri Mariamman temple
Evening bumboat cruise along the Singapore river
3: Breakfast, then across to Sentosa island
Full day ticket for Universal Studios Singapore
Seven themed zones, coasters and street shows
Optional: the Wings of Time show on the beach afterwards
4: Breakfast and check out, then private transfer to Changi
Optional: flight from Singapore to Denpasar, which we can add
Arrival in Bali and private transfer to your Kuta hotel
Rest of the day free near the beach
5: Breakfast, then a full day out with your own car and guide
Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani
Tegenungan waterfall and the Tegalalang rice terraces
A turn on the jungle swing above the valley
6: Breakfast, then north to the Handara gate for photographs
Ulun Danu Beratan, the temple standing on the lake
Sunset at Tanah Lot, the sea temple on the rocks
Evening back in Kuta at your own pace
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: City first, island second. Singapore is for the big nights out, Bali is for the slow mornings that follow.
expert.tip: Fly Singapore to Denpasar in the morning so you still get a Kuta sunset on moving day. We can add that leg to your package, along with seats together on both flights.

summary: Seven days across two countries: three nights in Singapore with a night safari, a city tour, the river by bumboat and Universal Studios, then three nights in Bali for Kintamani, the rice terraces and sunset at Tanah Lot.
included: Included: 6 nights with daily breakfast; private airport transfers in both cities; Night Safari with tram ride; Singapore city tour; Singapore river cruise; Universal Studios day ticket; Kintamani and jungle swing tour; Bedugul and Tanah Lot sunset tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Singapore to Denpasar flight, which we can add; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
